If it was further back than the rocket, which it appears to be, it would be going even faster. A peregrine falcon in its rapid dive reaches up to 200 miles per hour, so whatever it is it's traveling many times faster than a bird.

I don't necessarily think this is related, but it's a really interesting coincidence and in any case figuring out what it is is an interesting problem in its own right. The fact it passed over a rocket within a small fraction of a second of its explosion just makes it more interesting.
